subject: What Changed to Your Credit Card Today?
summary: Two Axis Bank cards get steeper penalty and forex fees, and six IndusInd Bank cards are marked Discontinued.

items.card_name: Axis Bank Freecharge Plus Credit Card
items.summary: Late payment fees rise to ₹1,200 to ₹1,300 with a recurring ₹100 MAD charge, and forex markup jumps from 1.5% to 3.5% plus taxes.
Same late payment and forex fee hikes as the Freecharge Plus card, plus a clarified Nil late-fee threshold under ₹500.
